coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using the nine ground-truth variable entries as the scoring units, only attack_type fully matches: AutoDAN (token-level) and PAIR (prompt-level). Thus, 1/9 entries match, rounded to 11%. Other entries have partial conceptual overlap but incorrect or missing operational settings.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design omits the fixed 100-token suffix length and specified attacker models, query budgets, and prompt-edit levels. It replaces the prescribed defender models and alignment settings with one unspecified model and different defenses. Template and safety-prompt settings do not match the prescribed conditions. HarmBench replaces MaliciousInstruct, and an open-source judge with a custom compliance rubric replaces GPT-4-based ASRAgent. The keyword classifier only partially matches ASRPrefix. Memory and additional outcomes are introduced outside the ground-truth design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the highest ASRs for strong attackers against weak defenders, reduced ASRs under strong defenses, the effectiveness of stacked defenses, or the dataset- and attack-specific interaction patterns.
